forWhat: Every question the engine has made, ready to print. Every one sits on a numbered worksheet.
Any member of staff can reword a question or remove it.

layout.shows: A short note on where the questions come from.
Questions that may be too easy or too hard, and new mistakes children make, each with a decision.
How many questions each skill has, at each level.
Search, choices of grade, level and kind, and the list. [[Open]] opens one question.

jobs.title: Correct a question's wording
steps: Under [[Correct the wording]], change the words and say what was wrong. Keep the numbers as they are, so the answer cannot change.
Press [[Save correction]]. The new wording is saved and the old wording will not print again.

jobs.title: Remove a question
steps: Open the question. Under [[Remove]], say why.
Press [[Remove this question]]. It will not print again. The worksheets it was on are replaced with new ones.

jobs.title: Decide what answers propose
steps: Under [[What children's answers propose]], read each question and how children found it.
Press [[Remove from the bank]] or [[Keep it]].
For a new mistake, give it a name and press [[Adopt it as a mistake]], or press [[Reject]].

buttons.label: Save correction
buttons.does: Saves the new wording as a new question and retires the old one.
buttons.doesNot: Do not change the numbers: the answer must stay the same.

buttons.label: Remove this question
buttons.does: Retires the question and the worksheets it was on, and deals new worksheets.
buttons.doesNot: If the engine cannot be reached, nothing is changed.
